name: Magnus Lund
bio:
Magnus's entry into the high-octane world of motorsport HR began with a chance encounter at a local karting event. Initially volunteering to help with registration, he quickly recognized the importance of efficient team management. His methodical approach, honed through years of independent study, caught the attention of a small racing team, where he began managing driver schedules and coordinating logistics. 

Now, Magnus brings a blend of precision and adaptability to his HR role. He believes in fostering a supportive and transparent work environment where talent can thrive. His strength lies in his ability to identify potential conflicts and address them proactively, ensuring smooth operations and a cohesive team dynamic. He's not afraid to implement innovative solutions to improve employee satisfaction and retention, always aiming to create a winning team both on and off the track.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Magnus is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets on his desk.
Prefers to conduct interviews while walking.
